sections.name: Token Usage Rules
rules: All colors MUST use semantic aliases (color-*), not primitive values directly in components
All spacing MUST use space-* tokens; no raw px values in component stylesheets
PHI fields MUST apply color-surface-phi background and 🔒 prefix icon (UXR-402)
AI-generated content MUST apply color-border-ai left border + Badge/AI (UXR-403)
Disabled states MUST use 40% opacity; no pointer events
Focus ring MUST be 3px solid color-border-focus (#1A56DB), 2px offset (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11)

implementation.mutual_exclusion: Never show AI + Verified badges simultaneously on same field

breakpoints.375px: 4-col grid; hamburger menu; SlotGrid 1-col; touch targets ≥44×44px

sections.name: Accessibility Notes
requirements: Focus ring: 3px solid #1A56DB, 2px offset — all interactive elements
All form fields: htmlFor/id association; aria-describedby for errors (UXR-203, UXR-204)
Screen reader must announce code verification decision changes (SCR-014)

cases.solution: Truncate at 30 chars; full name in tooltip on hover/focus
Non-PHI form state saved to sessionStorage; restored post-login
